title: Add source/API contract drift checks
summary: Add source/API contract drift checks under the checks layer so code↔code and KB↔code drift can be detected before gateway review relies on manual inspection.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki has deterministic source/API contract check evidence that horizontal/gateway workflows can consume for public facades, tool registrations, and documented package surfaces.
acceptance: Contract snapshot captures tool names, command names, public API facade exports, and package entry surfaces relevant to CodeWiki behavior.
Checks compare current source contract to documented/expected contract and produce actionable diffs.
Snapshot tests cover wiki_* naming and prevent stale internal tool names from silently reappearing.
Contract generation is deterministic and not canonical truth unless explicitly accepted.
non_goals: Do not publish or version a public API package contract beyond local check evidence.
Do not snapshot implementation-private internals without documented ownership reason.

delta.desired: Source/API contract evidence lives under flat checks layer and supports horizontal/gateway drift checks.
delta.current: Code↔code consistency is mostly enforced by typecheck/tests and package smoke tests.
delta.closure: Close when contract checks feed audit/gateway/test evidence and validation passes.
